messages.content: 找出投資的淨現值（NPV），給定現金流量=[200,300,400,500]，折扣率為10%，和初始投資為$2000。

function.name: calculate_NPV
function.description: Calculate the NPV (Net Present Value) of an investment, considering a series of future cash flows, discount rate, and an initial investment. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

discount_rate.description: The discount rate to use. This is a float type value.

initial_investment.description: The initial investment. Default is 0 if not specified.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute NPV with given cash flows [200,300,400,500], discount rate=10% or 0.1, initial investment $2000.

The formula: NPV = -initial + sum_{t=1}^{n} CF_t / (1+r)^t.

Compute:

CF1=200/(1+0.1)=200/1.1≈181.8182
CF2=300/(1.1^2)=300/1.21≈247.9339
CF3=400/(1.1^3)=400/1.331≈300.6015
CF4=500/(1.1^4)=500/1.4641≈341.4634

Sum ≈181.82+247.93+300.60+341.46=1072.81 approx.

Subtract initial 2000 gives NPV=-892.19 roughly negative.
